answer: Each identity must run a verifiable delay function chain seeded by its public key, posting a checkpoint hourly with a proof verifiers check in milliseconds. Squaring is sequential, so every key needs its own dedicated core. Voting weight grows with chain length, like willow rings, so new keys count for little; a mirror of another chain fails the seed check. Timber-grade influence takes months, costing about ten dollars of rented CPU per fake monthly.
